resources.string: Send suggestions, bug reports or feature requests to the developers

Submit the user\'s feedback (suggestions, bug reports or feature requests) to the development team. No login required. The content parameter is required; the optional contact info will be appended to the feedback so the developers can follow up.
Feedback content, required, up to 2000 characters. Describe the problem, suggestion or feature request in detail.
Optional contact info (email, QQ, WeChat, etc.) so the developers can reach the user for follow-up.
Feedback submitted successfully. Thank you! The developers will review it as soon as possible, and you can check for replies on the feedback page.
Feedback content exceeds the length limit (max %1$d characters)
